scope: T2 only. Retrospective observational diagnostics of four already observed seasons. No simulation, card estimation, engine modifications, no unseen season download.

acquisition.perTeam: For teams with season movers (>=1 played game each of >=2 franchises), acquire the same full-season metrics with TeamID/DefTeamID filters. No player selection by outcome. No DateTo, all regular season; explicitly not a pre-cutoff prediction.
acquisition.cache: Only new directory. Failed/empty endpoints stay missing; never zero-fill. Existing calendar55 defensetracking inventory only, not full-season substitute.
acquisition.teamFilterAudit: Filtered tracking/hustle/advanced must not exceed official player GP in that franchise (GP/G where available). Matchups lack team column and GP is pair count: compare child GP to official player franchise GP and global pair GP; reject failing player rows; team split is not claimed if counts fail.

metrics.rimSuppression: 100*(official NS_LT_06_PCT - LT_06_PCT); personal 6ft, not PBP paint
metrics.onDefRtg: 100*opponent points / fractional defensive possessions, positive sign reversed for correlations
metrics.onOffDef: matched played-game OFF DefRtg minus ON DefRtg; not an isolated player coefficient
metrics.onOffRimShare: 100*(OFF opponent paint FGA/FGA - ON paint FGA/FGA); paint includes restricted and non-RA paint
metrics.onOffThreeShare: 100*(OFF opponent 3PA/FGA - ON 3PA/FGA); lower 3P frequency is not inherently better defense
metrics.matchupSuppression: For each OFF player use own 2P/3P season FG rates as expected makes; sum expected minus actual / matchup FGA, *100
metrics.usageWeightedMatchupSuppression: Same numerator and denominator weighted by opponent season USG_PCT (Advanced; absent => missing, never equal weight fallback)
metrics.defensiveLoad: PARTIAL_POSS-weighted opponent USG_PCT, not arbitrary strength score
metrics.hustleRate: totals / official franchise minutes *36; minutes and games reconciled. Count missing columns separately.
metrics.officialDefRtg: Advanced DEF_RATING is on-court team efficiency, not box-derived independent individual value

selection.primaryAdjacent: Both seasons >=500 official total minutes; dominant franchise >=60% minutes in each. Same team iff dominant franchise identical; mover iff different. Exclude ambiguous multi-team seasons from primary, report count.
selection.withinSeasonMove: Two or more franchises in logs, sorted by first played date; compare first and last eligible team (>=300 minutes each). Overlapping date intervals or returned-to-original team => omit and list. This is documented season move, not automatically verified trade.

comparisons.adjacent: All three adjacent transitions separately and pooled after centering within transition. One row per player/transition; repeated player stays clustered.
comparisons.withinSeason: Each season separately and pooled after season centering; no manual transaction labels. Explicit limitation if transaction reason unverified.
comparisons.teamCorrelation: Minutes-weighted mean individual indicator vs own franchise negative official box possession-proxy DefRtg. 30 teams per season, equal season weight after centering. Also compare leave-player-out OFF defense in matched games to expose context association.
comparisons.context: Report raw ON, matched ON/OFF and team-centered ON side by side. Correlation loss after switching is consistent with context contamination, not proof of causality. No inferred card weights fitted to these answers.

uncertainty.method: Paired player-ID cluster and franchise cluster multiplicative bootstrap; franchise pair gets average of old/new franchise multiplicities. Pooled rows share player multiplicity across transitions. Team-correlation bootstrap franchise across seasons. No simulation seed exists for these observed metrics; do not substitute seed-only intervals. Pearson primary, Spearman secondary point estimate. Fewer than10 usable pairs => not estimable.

proposals: Only after measurements. Favor direct event/process observations over raw ON/team shadows. Expected improvements explicitly hypotheses; no card modifications and no numeric RMSE gain claimed without simulation.
